children: Sushi has started monthly xSUSHI buybacks under its approved revised buyback program, establishing a recurring purchase schedule for the staked token. The program channels protocol-approved funds into direct demand for xSUSHI, giving stakers a defined value-accrual mechanism tied to monthly execution rather than one-off interventions.

Recurring buybacks give xSUSHI holders a confirmed route through which value can accrue to the staked token, since each monthly cycle adds structured demand independent of discretionary decisions. The practical effect depends on buyback size, which Sushi has not disclosed, so the mechanism is confirmed while its per-cycle weight remains unknown. Traders can track execution through the monthly schedule itself.
The Sushi Strategic Reserve + Revised Buyback Program has passed both rounds of voting.
- Weekly SUSHI purchases into the Reserve start Monday, September 7th.

title: Sushi: Monthly xSUSHI Buybacks Begin Under Revised Buyback Program - 01 Oct 2026
